notes: Delta design: run each query with and without the skill loaded. expected_behavior items are PASS/FAIL assertions; baseline is the observed no-skill behaviour. Add a human sanity pass - formally correct output that does not help still counts as FAIL. Record tokens and wall time per run alongside pass/fail. Activation is measured once for the whole family in evals/activation.json.

evals.query: which phase should this defect go back to?
expected_behavior: routes by root cause, not by which phase noticed it
for behaviour no requirement covers, names analysis AND implementation
evals.baseline: sends every defect back to the developer

expected_behavior: gives the exact fields - id, code, severity, target_phase, message, evidence, iteration, resolved
one JSON object per line, append-only
evals.baseline: invents a plausible schema that other agents will not match

evals.query: that finding is fixed, delete its line
expected_behavior: refuses to delete - the file is the audit trail
rewrites the line with resolved true plus a resolution

evals.query: where do the generated source files go?
expected_behavior: into the real project tree, never into .sdlc/
evals.baseline: writes source into the state directory alongside the artifacts
